title: How long have you ...? (present perfect 4)
summary: Present perfect (в том числе continuous) для вопроса **How long ...?**: действие или состояние началось в прошлом и продолжается сейчас.
ru:
## Главная идея
По-русски мы говорим в настоящем: «Я живу здесь три года», «Она знает его давно». В английском так сказать нельзя! Если ситуация началась в прошлом и **длится до сих пор**, нужен **present perfect**.
> I **have lived** here for three years. — Я живу здесь три года.
> How long **have you known** Tom? — Как давно ты знаешь Тома?

## Настоящее vs present perfect
| Сейчас | Как долго |
|---|---|
| She **is** in Ireland. | She **has been** in Ireland since Monday. |
| I **know** Sarah. | I **have known** her for a long time. |
| They **are** married. | They **have been** married for five years. |

- ~~They are married for five years.~~ → They **have been** married for five years.
- ~~How long do you know her?~~ → How long **have you known** her?

## Глаголы состояния
С **be, know, have, live** (состояние) используем **have + причастие**.
> I've **had** this phone since April. — Этот телефон у меня с апреля.
> My parents **have lived** here all their lives. — Мои родители живут здесь всю жизнь.

## Present perfect continuous (have been + -ing)
С действиями (learn, wait, watch, rain, work) — **have been + -ing**.
> I've **been learning** English for two years. — Я учу английский два года.
> It's **been raining** all day. — Дождь идёт весь день.
> How long **have you been waiting**? — Как долго ты ждёшь?

## for и since
- **for** + период: for two hours, for a week
- **since** + начало: since Monday, since 2020
(подробно — в юните 19)

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I am here since 9 o'clock.~~ → I **have been** here since 9 o'clock.
- ~~I am learning English for a year.~~ → I **have been learning** English for a year.
en:
## The main idea
In English we can't use the present simple for something that started in the past and still continues. We use the **present perfect**.
> I **have lived** here for three years.
> How long **have you known** Tom?

## Present vs present perfect
| Now | How long |
|---|---|
| She **is** in Ireland. | She **has been** in Ireland since Monday. |
| I **know** Sarah. | I **have known** her for a long time. |
| They **are** married. | They **have been** married for five years. |

- ~~They are married for five years.~~ → They **have been** married for five years.
- ~~How long do you know her?~~ → How long **have you known** her?

## State verbs
With **be, know, have, live** we use **have + past participle**.
> I've **had** this phone since April.
> My parents **have lived** here all their lives.

## Present perfect continuous (have been + -ing)
With actions (learn, wait, watch, rain, work) we use **have been + -ing**.
> I've **been learning** English for two years.
> It's **been raining** all day.
> How long **have you been waiting**?

## for and since
- **for** + a period: for two hours, for a week
- **since** + the start: since Monday, since 2020

## Common mistakes
- ~~I am here since 9 o'clock.~~ → I **have been** here since 9 o'clock.
- ~~I am learning English for a year.~~ → I **have been learning** English for a year.
structure:
## Present perfect simple
| Утверждение | Отрицание | Вопрос |
|---|---|---|
| I have lived here for years. | I haven't lived here long. | How long have you lived here? |
| She has known him since 2019. | She hasn't known him long. | How long has she known him? |

## Present perfect continuous
| Утверждение | Отрицание | Вопрос |
|---|---|---|
| I have been working. | I haven't been working. | How long have you been working? |
| It has been raining. | It hasn't been raining. | How long has it been raining? |

## Краткие формы
- I've / you've / we've / they've been
- he's / she's / it's been
- haven't / hasn't

## Формула
> **How long** + have / has + подлежащее + past participle / been + -ing ... ?
> Подлежащее + have / has + (been + -ing) + **for / since** ...

exercises.instruction: Допишите второе предложение (present perfect от глагола **be**, **know**, **have** или **live**).
exercises.example: Anna is in hospital. She has been in hospital since Monday.

items.text: Tom is ill. He {{has been|'s been}} ill for a week.
I know Kate. I {{have known|'ve known}} her for ten years.

We live in Osh. We {{have lived|'ve lived}} here all our lives.
She has a bike. She {{has had|'s had}} it since March.
Max works in a bank. He {{has worked|'s worked}} there for two years.
